name: Drazhoath the Ashen
canonNotes: Lord of the Black Fortress, sent there in near-exile after losing favour in Zharr-Naggrund's brutal politics, who rose to rule it through cunning and ruthless ambition.
A potent sorcerer who rides a Cinderbreath bull and dreams of returning to power.
voiceNotes: Bitter, calculating and ambitious; speaks of power, fire and debts owed.
Resents the priesthood that exiled him.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
